description: Import a survey dataset into TopoCal. TopoCal is open with an empty drawing. On the Desktop there is a folder called 'SurveyData' containing the file 'survey_points.csv'. This CSV file contains 204 survey points (UTM Zone 13N coordinates) representing a simulated field survey in the Colorado foothills area. Each row contains: PointNumber, Easting, Northing, Elevation, Code. Open TopoCal and import these points. In TopoCal's Spanish menu interface: go to 'Archivo' (File) and look for an import or 'Abrir' option for ASCII/text files, navigate to the SurveyData folder on the Desktop, select 'survey_points.csv', and configure the import settings (comma separator, columns: PointNumber, X/Easting, Y/Northing, Z/Elevation, Code). After importing, the 204 survey points should be visible in the TopoCal drawing area.
